    <span class="sb-eyebrow">Engineer · Researcher · Writer · Lecturer</span>
    <h1>I take AI from research to <span class="hl">production</span>.</h1>
    <p><strong>Hi, I'm Sabrine.</strong> An applied mathematics engineer by training (Télécom Paris), I've spent 10 years in innovation and R&amp;D teams, first in energy, then on water networks, where I contributed to a patent on leak prediction.</p>
    <p>Then I wanted to point what I knew at health. I completed a Master's in computational neuroscience at CentraleSupélec and moved into biosignals and medical imaging with AI startups. Today I build pipelines for multimodal brain imaging (MEG, fMRI and structural MRI) that work for both sides: rigorous enough for research, robust enough for a product.</p>
    <p>Along the way, I teach, write, and help open the door for more women in tech.</p>
